category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, shorten causal pooling from four states to three while retaining the 0.8 current-state and 0.2 recent-mean blend. This tests whether a narrower window reduces stale-interest smoothing. Existing padding masks and final-real-position inference remain intact; checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor check agree.

response.change_summary: Use padding-aware causal three-state pooling across all four NextItNet category models, with matching checkpoint metadata and predictor validation.
